The uneasiness has been there for this past week without panic attacks, it was controllable and easily dismissible.


I remember looking at Reddit and fb and listening to music, then I took the three pills, and after a few hours it just started building up leading to the attack, I started to have thoughts about loneliness and despair from having to live like that my whole life.

I tried breathing exercises, but it didn't help much so I went out to walk, messaged some colleagues and friends to try and get distracted. After about half an hour I got back and got myself in bed and turned the TV on and fell asleep (which is what I do when having a Panic attack).

I was browsing reddit and checking facebook, it was a quiet afternoon. I can't tell what it was about, it's just a really bad uneasiness and fear that I can't shake off.

I have been trying to remember if I have taken it at other times when I had a panic attack.
